bracket_length = 70.0
bracket_width = 40.0

rib_count = 4
hole_diameter = 6.0
hole_offset = 10.0

base = Pos(0, 0, bracket_thickness/2) * Box(bracket_length, bracket_width, bracket_thickness)

rib_spacing = (bracket_width - rib_thickness) / (rib_count - 1)
rib_z = bracket_thickness + rib_height/2
ribs = Pos(0, -rib_spacing * 1.5, rib_z) * Box(bracket_length, rib_thickness, rib_height)
ribs = ribs + Pos(0, -rib_spacing * 0.5, rib_z) * Box(bracket_length, rib_thickness, rib_height)
ribs = ribs + Pos(0, rib_spacing * 0.5, rib_z) * Box(bracket_length, rib_thickness, rib_height)
ribs = ribs + Pos(0, rib_spacing * 1.5, rib_z) * Box(bracket_length, rib_thickness, rib_height)

result = base + ribs

hole_z = (bracket_thickness + rib_height) / 2
hole_h = bracket_thickness + rib_height + 2
result = result - Pos(-bracket_length/2 + hole_offset, 0, hole_z) * Cylinder(hole_diameter/2, hole_h)
result = result - Pos(bracket_length/2 - hole_offset, 0, hole_z) * Cylinder(hole_diameter/2, hole_h)

part = result
part.name = "bracket_with_ribs"
